summary:
Detailed implementation plan for enhanced intuitive, visual RBAC in the BPMP Platform.
Covers 3 dedicated visual tab views (Phân quyền theo Process, Phân quyền theo Element, Phân quyền theo Queue) with interactive Permission Matrix Grid toggle, slide-over configuration drawer with role search & dynamic expression filters, and granular permission actions (View, Execute/Claim, Reassign, Cancel).
